name: Deep Pockets
description: Gain 3 extra gold each shopping phase.

name: First Strike
description: Your first spell each Cycle deals 50% more direct damage.

name: Finisher
description: Your final spell each Cycle deals 50% more direct damage.

name: Crescendo
description: Each preceding spell this Cycle adds 5% direct damage.

name: Alternation
description: After a different domain, your spell deals 20% more damage, healing and Ward.

name: Opening Ward
description: Start combat with 100 Ward.

name: Heavy Hitters
description: Printed 3T spells deal 40% more direct damage.

name: Momentum
description: Three consecutive printed 1T spells grant 5 Fury.

name: Glass Cannon
description: Deal 30% more damage. Lose 125 maximum Health.

name: Blood Magic
description: Self-damage grants 3 Regeneration.

name: Blood Infusion
description: Self-damage grants 1 Potency.

name: Reckless Loop
description: Skip the reshuffle tick. Lose 25 Health at each new Cycle.

name: Last Stand
description: Below 30% Health, spells start 1T faster (minimum 1T).

name: Second Wind
description: Once per combat, reaching 30% Health restores 120 Health.

name: Specialist
description: Your most common domain has triple shop weight.

name: Recycler
description: Trashing a spell refunds 80% of its gold value, rounded down.

name: Scavenger
description: Your first two rerolls each shop are free.

name: Wildfire
description: Applying Poison while you have Heat also deals 20 damage.

name: Super Poison
description: Your Poison deals 100% more damage. Stacks with other damage modifiers.

name: Toxic Start
description: Your opponent starts combat with 5 Poison and 1 Curse.

name: Cursed
description: Curse adds one tick to enemy reshuffles.

name: Hot Stuff
description: While you have Heat, deal 10% more damage and take 10% more damage.

name: Friendly Imp
description: Direct healing restores your living Imp first; excess healing restores you.

name: Bloom
description: When your Poison expires, deal 60 damage.

name: Criticality
description: Crossing from below 10 to 10+ Potency grants 15 Heat.

name: Monster
description: Gain 200 maximum Health, plus 100 extra for each level gained.

name: Tough Skin
description: Resilience reduces damage by 65%.
